question: persister
constraint: with only a single time point measured per sample
prompt:
Constraint: every one of your ideas must be carried out with only a single time point measured per sample. Within that constraint, make the ideas as informative as possible.

Research question: "What measurements or analyses would best reveal why a small fraction of genetically identical cancer cells survive targeted drug treatment?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Paired pre-treatment and survivor single-cell multiome
ideas.description: Profile scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq (or CITE-seq) of untreated cells and of cells surviving a single post-treatment endpoint, then test whether survivors were already enriched for particular transcriptional or chromatin states before drug exposure. This separates pre-existing persister programs from states induced by the drug.

ideas.title: Endpoint lineage-barcode bottleneck analysis
ideas.description: Label cells with a heritable DNA barcode library before treatment, then sequence barcodes in the pre-treatment pool and the surviving pool at one endpoint. Few dominant barcodes would indicate that survival is pre-determined in a small clone, while a broad, even distribution would point to stochastic survival.

ideas.title: Fixed-cell imaging of quiescence and pathway-activity reporters
ideas.description: Use a single fixed snapshot of FUCCI or Ki-67/EdU-based cell-cycle state together with a kinase translocation reporter (e.g., ERK-KTR) or phospho-ERK immunofluorescence in the same cells. Each cell then carries its own quiescence and residual target-pathway activity, which can be used to test whether survivors are non-cycling and pathway-reactivated.

ideas.title: Spatial multiplexed imaging of drug-treated tumor or organoid niches
ideas.description: Run cyclic immunofluorescence or imaging mass cytometry on a treated tumor section or organoid, co-staining the drug target, hypoxia markers, stromal and vascular markers. Mapping survivors against their neighbors and distance to vasculature or stroma can reveal whether niche position, rather than cell-intrinsic state, governs persistence.

ideas.title: Mass cytometry of efflux, chromatin, and drug-retention states
ideas.description: Use CyTOF to measure drug efflux transporters (e.g., ABCB1), chromatin-regulator and histone-mark levels, and survival-pathway proteins in single cells, combined with a fluorescent or isotope-labeled drug-retention readout. This links individual cells' drug accumulation and epigenetic state to their survival, identifying which protein-level features are associated with persistence.
